message: FORGE-BOARD-3.1 says moving cmd_add's explicit --ac guard into the --spec branch is sufficient, but check_story_contract runs before that branch and independently rejects empty acceptance_criteria; no-spec without --ac cannot pass unless the shared validator is explicitly adapted or reordered.

notes: Confirmed — check_story_contract (roadmap.py:149), called at cmd_add:498 BEFORE the spec/no-spec branch, independently requires acceptance_criteria. Full fix, all within roadmap.py (in scope): (1) in cmd_add, set the adhoc markers (origin='adhoc', spec_debt_reason) BEFORE calling check_story_contract; (2) make check_story_contract EXEMPT the acceptance_criteria requirement when the item is adhoc (item.get('origin')=='adhoc' or item.get('spec_debt_reason')) — import/derive/--spec stories are never adhoc, so they still require ACs (keeps AC#2, --spec-without---ac fails); (3) drop the now-redundant inline --ac guard at :475-477. Result: --no-spec without --ac records spec-debt; --spec without --ac still fails. --ac stays accepted-but-optional on --no-spec. Do NOT weaken the 0014 spec-debt planning gate.
